output.reason: pipeline_planning spans three independent cross-layer specialist reviews: decoder/template structure, stream/beat data-transfer order, and memory/runtime dataflow. No active SACG contamination barrier, retry request, or backtrack request blocks decomposition, and the existing checker-passing candidate artifact does not require a duplicate evidence gate, so parallel_group=0 specialists are sufficient.

handoff_rule.condition: No checker errors and stage/template/attention boundary observations are traceable to constraint.model.decoder, constraint.shape.model, constraint.template.library, and constraint.arch.design_space.
handoff_rule.consumer: team_aggregate consumes the review record only after acceptance checkers pass.

subtasks.objective: Verify that the planned stages preserve GPT-2 decoder operator order and expose correct residual, attention, norm, and MLP template boundaries without free-form RTL generation.

decision_authority: May flag Stage-3 planning blockers for model/shape/template boundary inconsistencies.
May request bounded artifact correction within pipeline_planning.
May not promote later-stage hardware timing, throughput, or board readiness claims.
role_assignment.mission: Check whether pipeline stages preserve decoder operator order and expose residual, attention, and template boundaries.
out_of_scope: Do not assign concrete DDR base addresses or XDMA ABI address translation.
Do not synthesize or simulate RTL.
Do not treat symbolic first-order latency as timing evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Audit artifact.stage3.pipeline_plan stages against constraint.model.decoder operator order.
Audit attention/qkv/head mapping and position encoding boundary against constraint.shape.model.
Confirm every stage is bound to a trusted template id and no free-form RTL claim exists.
Detect residual-skip and branch/join boundary mismatches between the semantic graph and SACG constraints.

subtasks.title: Review decoder stage decomposition and template boundaries

handoff_rule.condition: Data order traces, transfer counts, FIFO depth/branch joins, and deadlock/backpressure checkers all pass with no new errors.
handoff_rule.consumer: memory_dataflow_engineer and team_aggregate consume only checker-passing review records.

subtasks.objective: Check token/tile/lane/word transfer order, ready/valid behavior, FIFO depths, and producer-consumer branch/join liveness risks across data_edges and stream_edges.

decision_authority: May flag Stage-3 planning blockers for stream order, transfer count, branch/join, or liveness inconsistencies.
May require buffer-plan correction within pipeline_planning.
May not replace deadlock_watchdog evidence with symbolic latency estimates.
role_assignment.mission: Check token/tile/lane/transfer-unit order, valid/ready assumptions, and producer-consumer handoff risks.
out_of_scope: Do not allocate or bind concrete host/core address bases.
Do not claim board-level DDR timing closure.
primary_responsibilities: Mirror audit data_edges and stream_edges to ensure exact edge identity, tensor shape, transfer order, and byte count.
Verify all beats obey stream_beats_per_axi_beat and full_beats_only policies under the declared AXI width.
Check bounded FIFO depths for branch splits and joins under ready/valid backpressure.
Detect deadlock/liveness risks from split policy and join policy.

subtasks.title: Review stream/beat order and liveness constraints

handoff_rule.condition: Memory/runtime plan check, address map check, and boundary contract check pass; region sizing formulas and runtime sequences remain traceable to input targets and numeric policy.
handoff_rule.consumer: team_aggregate consumes after all specialist reviews are accepted.

subtasks.objective: Verify that pipeline planning leaves explicit, checker-backed hooks for activation/weight regions, DDR AXI layout, XDMA runtime configuration, and later implementation evidence without claiming concrete address assignment.

decision_authority: May flag Stage-3 planning blockers for memory/runtime dataflow inconsistencies.
May require bounded correction of memory_schedule or runtime_config_requirements within pipeline_planning.
May not issue DDR timing closure or board deployment pass claims.
role_assignment.mission: Check that pipeline planning leaves explicit hooks for weights, activations, DDR layout, runtime config, and later implementation evidence.
out_of_scope: Do not assign concrete DDR base addresses or host/core address translation.
Do not claim implementation, synthesis, or board runtime readiness.
primary_responsibilities: Audit required_regions against activation/weight size formulas and 64-byte alignment.
Audit board AXI width/protocol and runtime XDMA command sequences against constraint.memory.board, constraint.runtime.board, and constraint.deployment.board.
Confirm memory_schedule does not claim concrete host/core base addresses or output-header ABI details.
Check ping-pong weight policy, streamed activations, and runtime sequence length constraints are consistent with later Stage-5 obligations.

subtasks.title: Review memory and runtime dataflow implications
